verdict.rationale: ASA (Authorization Stream Access) documents a JIT-style funding model where the customer's system approves/funds each authorization in real time via an HTTP interface [lithic-docs-2][lithic-docs-16], which covers half of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a prefunded-balance funding option, nor any content comparing cash-flow tradeoffs between prefunded and JIT models for a finance lead audience. Missing for 10: explicit prefunded-balance funding mechanism documentation, and any comparative cash-flow/tradeoff guidance between the two funding models.
